title: AffineEtaleColimitPresentation
statement: Let I be a nonempty directed preorder, D : I^op → Scheme an inverse system of schemes in universe u with affine transitions and qcqs stages, and c a limiting cone with point X. Write C_i for the full affine étale site of D_i and C for that of X, with their finite standard étale precoverages [def-weil-pbc-full-affine-etale-site]. Suppose a normalized coherent system U_ij, v_i, gamma_ijk and delta_ij is given: U_ii = identity, gamma with either adjacent indices equal and delta_ii are identity comparisons, gamma satisfies the associativity cocycle and delta the cone cocycle. Assume each U_ij and v_i preserves standard covers and all cospan pullbacks, is continuous, and its continuous pushforward on Type u sheaves has a finite-limit-preserving left adjoint. Assume object descent, map descent with the delta conjugation formula, eventual equality under U_ij of stage maps equal under v_i, and descent and reflection of Fin n covering families up to source and target isomorphisms. Then there exist a strict diagram F : I → Cat.{u, u+1}, precoverages Q_i, equivalences e_i : C_i → F_i, functors v'_i : F_i → C, and comparison isomorphisms theta_ij : e_i F_ij ≅ U_ij e_j and eta_i : e_i v'_i ≅ v_i. Q_i have isomorphisms, finite indexed composition, finite indexed base change and covering pullbacks [def-weil-pbc-finite-precoverage], and all their covering presieves are finite. The e_i preserve and reflect coverings. F_ij preserves coverings and all cospan pullbacks. F_ij v'_j = v'_i strictly, and v'_j(theta_ij.hom_A), eta_j.hom_(U_ij A), delta_ij.hom_A compose to eta_i.hom_A, expressed by equality in Arrow. F_ij and v'_i are continuous and their pushforwards on Type u sheaves have finite-limit-preserving left adjoints. There are a cocone K of F, a functor W : K.pt → C and a precoverage P on K.pt such that the object and arrow cocones of K are set colimits, K_i W = v'_i strictly, P consists exactly of images of stage covering presieves transported along equalities of target objects, P has the four site properties above, W is an equivalence, and a presieve R belongs to P iff R.map W covers in C.

proof.text: W4 proves the finite-family construction in the new subordinate node: strictification, finite site axioms, continuity and exact adjoints, strict coefficient compatibility, object and arrow colimits, W equivalence, and exact stage-cover image description. Its final criterion is R covering iff R is finite and its W-image covers. This is a completed strict part of the argument, not a proof of the original conclusion.

STATEMENT-DISPUTED: removing the finiteness qualification in the last covering-reflection iff is not justified by the labelled-pair route. For a constant identity system indexed by natural numbers, distinct labels (n,A) give an infinite presieve into (0,A) whose W-image is the singleton identity covering. Every image of a stage cover is finite. Moreover finite cover reflection by a fully faithful W forces every object fiber of W to be finite, as verified by finite_fibers_of_finite_cover_reflection in the item module. Conversely finite object fibers suffice for finite presieves to be detected by their image under a faithful functor; finite_cover_reflection_iff_finite_fibers proves the exact criterion for the finite inverse-image precoverage. Thus the prescribed raw-labelled construction cannot satisfy the final clause. The full existential statement is not refuted: a different presentation would require additional justification. Its original Lean statement and sorry remain unchanged.

proof_origin.place: W4: proved the complete finite-family construction; identified and formalized the arbitrary-presieve gap in the prescribed labelled presentation. No target statement is changed.

statement_change.what: The prior Lean attachment asserted unrestricted indexed composition and base change together with finite covers; even a singleton system over a field refutes this. It also derived the whole statement by contradicting the false strictification axiom. Withdraw the attachment. The source statement uses finite indexed coverings; the only actual caller needs object descent, now used directly.
